symptom: An activity replaced in place by `create or modify` (a retrieve swapped for a call microflow) came back with empty documentation, and no script could carry the text: describe never printed an activity's documentation and MDL had no spelling for it.
cause: Activity, decision and loop documentation was read and written by the backend but had no annotation: ActivityAnnotations stopped at @position/@caption/@color/@annotation/@excluded/@anchor.
fix: `@documentation 'text'` sets it on an action, decision or loop; describe prints it. It is a *string: nil states nothing, and the diff-then-patch matcher skips it only then (unstatedFields), in every mode — so a script without it keeps the stored activity and its text, and a changed text is never taken for layout.
insight: Adding a field to describe output is a matcher change too: diff-then-patch compares the declared statement with the stored one as describe prints it, so a newly printed field would have made every hand-written statement 'changed' and rebuilt — losing the very documentation it was meant to keep. Three guards caught the rest of the wiring: TestMergeStatementAnnotationsCopiesEveryField, TestKnownAnnotationsMatchTheVisitor (MDL059), and the grammar's annotationName list (DOCUMENTATION is a lexer keyword). Live on 11.16.1: re-run without the annotation is 'already in sync' with the text kept; the replacement carries what the script states; mx check 0 errors.
test: mdl/executor/activity_documentation_2328_test.go (builds, describes and parses back, unstated matches, changed text is not layout)
